author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: a single finger on a smooth blob with no curled-finger knuckles, so the hand read as a mitten or a rude gesture. After: tall index finger, two stepped knuckles with finger splits, 45-degree thumb with an r5 tip and a rounded palm; reads as a pointing-up hand at 48 in both themes.
omissions: Three curled fingers reduced to two knuckles (8-wide fingers in the 16 units beside the index finger).
